items.html: However, that these days of Purim are made in every single year, and it was not enough to do it only at that time — the reason is that the Holy One, blessed be He, in His mercies, wanted that illumination, which is renewed when the Mochin of Aba and Ima are within the female during the time of the dormita of ZA, not to be annulled ever, but in every single year, in those very days.
